# Word template fixtures

These macro-free DOTX files were saved by Microsoft Word. Author metadata was cleared.

- `blank-template-word.dotx` was saved from the packaged markdown-docx formatting template.
- `rich-template-word.dotx` contains body content, a custom style, an image, and populated headers and footers. It verifies that template inspection detects unsupported content.

The same fixtures cover DOTX instantiation in the ps-python-docx test suite.
